   - Using both gradient descent and gradient ascent phases to explore the optimization landscape
   - Employing a multi-component objective that considers peak reduction and narrow width improvement
   - Implementing a restart mechanism with dimension permutation to jump out of local optima

   The theory suggests that optimal solutions for minimum overlap problems often exhibit a sparse support structure, so we will combine unsupervised greedy thinning with structured matrix decomposition.
